nodes.description: IERC1155 public nft, the NFT contract used for transfers and balance checks
uint256 public price = 0.2 ether, unit price used in the multiplication check
uint256 public id, the ERC1155 token id sold by this contract
address payable public multisig, recipient of the contract balance
uint256 public start, sale start timestamp compared with block.timestamp
buy(uint256 amount) public payable, main sale entry point performing checks, NFT transfer and fund forwarding
supply() public view, returns the contract's ERC1155 balance for id
onERC1155Received callback returning the ERC1155 receiver selector
constructor setting multisig, start, nft address and id
msg.sender, caller address used in the tx.origin check, as NFT recipient and in the Buy event
block.timestamp, used to gate the sale start
tx.origin, compared against msg.sender to block contract callers
nft.safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id, amount, new bytes(0x0)), external NFT transfer that can invoke a receiver callback
multisig.transfer(address(this).balance), external value transfer of the whole contract balance
price.mul(amount) via Math library, multiplication used to validate msg.value
nft.balanceOf(address(this), id), external call used as supply source and purchase limit

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with tx.origin inside buy, enforcing the no-contracts restriction
tx.origin is read by buy and used as an access-control condition
block.timestamp gates execution of buy via require(block.timestamp >= start), a timestamp dependency
state variable start is read by buy for the timestamp comparison
the amount parameter drives the supply check, price check and NFT transfer amount
buy invokes supply() to validate the requested amount
buy executes price.mul(amount) to compute the required payment
state variable price is an operand of the multiplication
the amount parameter is an operand of the multiplication
buy calls nft.safeTransferFrom to deliver the tokens
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of safeTransferFrom
state variable id is passed as the token id of safeTransferFrom
the amount parameter is passed as the value of safeTransferFrom
the nft state variable is the contract on which safeTransferFrom is executed
an external NFT transfer is performed before the external multisig value transfer, allowing a callback/reentrant path mid-execution
buy forwards the entire contract balance through multisig.transfer
state variable multisig is the destination of the value transfer
supply() performs the external nft.balanceOf call
the nft state variable is the contract queried by balanceOf
state variable id is the token id queried by balanceOf
the ERC1155 safe transfer triggers the receiver callback implemented by onERC1155Received
constructor assigns the NFT contract address to nft
constructor assigns 36 to the state variable id
constructor assigns the multisig destination
constructor assigns the sale start timestamp
the _multisig parameter is stored into the multisig state variable
the _start parameter is stored into the start state variable

normalization_plan.reason: the amount parameter has no independent identity outside buy and should be folded into the buy function node
the _multisig constructor parameter only exists to initialize state and should be merged into the constructor node
the _start constructor parameter only exists to initialize state and should be merged into the constructor node
